summary: src/git.ts's three existence probes adopt `existsLoud`: the tip claim acquire reads over, removeWorktree's survival check, cherryPickAbort's sequencer state
tests: liveTipClaimPid throws when the claim path is present but unstattable
removeWorktree throws when the post-removal survival check cannot stat the path
cherryPickAbort throws when a sequencer-state path is present but unstattable
acceptance: Every existence gate in src/git.ts splits ENOENT from other stat failures; absent stays silent, and the tip claim's declared git-side silence is unchanged.
notes: Follow-on to STOPFLAG-TIPCLAIM-EXISTS-LOUD: `flume status` now refuses an unstattable tip claim while `acquireTipClaim`'s liveTipClaimPid reads the same path as no-claim and reclaims the tip — the higher-stakes half. ELOOP self-symlink is the root-safe fixture (tests/loopSupervisor.test.ts:122); the survival case needs `rm` mocked to a no-op (tests/git.test.ts:884). src/fsProbe.ts imports only node:fs — no cycle.

notes: Scope is the strict read alone. `readPendingTolerant` (`:3979`) declares and cites its degradation at the site, and the tick-verdict reads (`:655`/`:675`/`:710`) declare absent-to-empty — all four stay as written.

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests: isAwake throws when a phase's awake flag is present but unstattable
acceptance: isAwake and awake() take the same disposition on a non-ENOENT stat failure.
notes: No engine consumer — `Baton` is public API (src/index.ts:17), so the divergence ships to chains rather than biting a call site here. tests/Baton.test.ts:120 enumerates `existsSync` in its namespacedJoin source scan under a vacuity pin; that list moves in the same commit or the pin fails.
